entries.48aeb1731f0109d2: As its basic management policy, under the motto 'No prosperity without safety', it pursues securing safety and stable supply, aiming to become a supporter of comfortable and safe living. Over the medium to long term, while maintaining and developing the Living Business, centered on ＬＰ gas sales, it aims to develop the Aqua Business and the Medical and Industrial Gas Business into second and third pillars of earnings. To build its business portfolio, it intends to make each business independent and to seek scale benefits and greater efficiency and streamlining of management. It also plans to strengthen its sales capabilities and, through expansion measures such as acquiring sales rights and securing new sales destinations through Ｍ＆Ａ, to carry out sales activities that give top priority to increasing the number of users.

entries.803f5d752c3cc92d: It has a system in which its group's own facilities and bases handle the supply of gas and medical products. ＬＰ gas is supplied through a network of branches with the company's own filling facilities, and high-pressure gas is supplied through a system in which three bases (the Shiga Branch, the Nara Branch and Kinki Sanso) work together with the manufacturing and logistics departments. The Aqua Business has two of its own bottling plants and a home-delivery network operated by its own delivery staff, and in home medical care the group handles everything from rental of equipment based on physicians' prescriptions to maintenance, and inspection and repair of medical equipment.

entries.8bb6addf4d120a94: This business sells LP gas and housing equipment. In addition to the company, the consolidated subsidiaries Marushin Gas, Kohto Gas, Fumoto Shokai, Kakumaru Energy, Taiyo Propane and Kusanen sell in their respective areas, and Iwasaki Flowtech carries out equipment construction. The affiliates Ehime Benny and Five Star Gas also sell LP gas and equipment purchased from the company.
